answer: Random transcript audit works like a comet passing back over old ground: each epoch the chain replays one past answer under a fresh nonce issued at audit time, so a copy-paste Sybil farm cannot pre-bake replies. The challenged agent must re-derive its reasoning live; verifiers compare it to the stored derivation, and a karst-like fault line of two mismatches pushes the identity onto the manual-review ledge, freezing emission. Cost: re-deriving 11243 identities burns 276209 tokens, 40 operator hours, 58 days exposure.
